text_sections.label: Special Digivolution Condition
text_sections.text:
[Digivolve] Lv.5 w/[Greymon] in name or w/[ME]/[VB] trait: Cost 3
[DNA Digivolve] Red/yellow Lv.5 + black/purple Lv.5: Cost 0

text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text:
＜Security A. +1＞ ＜Decode (Lv.5 or lower w/[Agumon]/[Greymon] in name or w/[ME]/[VB] trait)＞
[On Play] [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] ＜De-Digivolve 2＞ 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, delete 1 of your opponent's lowest DP Digimon.
[Counter] [Once Per Turn] 2 of your Digimon may DNA digivolve into [Omnimon] or an [ME] or [VB] trait Digimon card in the hand. Then, you may change the attack target to 1 of your Digimon.

text_sections.label: Special Play Condition
text_sections.text: Assembly -6: Lv.5 × Lv.4 × Lv.3, all w/[Agumon]/[Greymon] in name or w/[ME]/[VB] trait

extracted.name: WarGreymon

qa.answer:
Yes, both have to be XX.
For example, "1 level 4 or lower Digimon card with the [CS] trait or that is yellow or black" means either "1 level 4 or lower Digimon card with the [CS] trait" or "1 level 4 or lower Digimon card that is yellow or black." In both cases, the card must be level 4 or lower.
qa.question: If a text says "XX card with AA or BB," does that mean AA and BB both have to be XX?

qa.answer: Yes, they must each satisfy the requirements.
qa.question: For this card's Assembly requirements, are each of the level 5, level 4, and level 3 cards required to have [Agumon] or [Greymon] in their name or the [ME] or [VB] trait?

qa.answer: The Digimon being attacked leaves play and the attack target disappears.
qa.question: While an opponent's Digimon is attacking, if I activate this card's effect and DNA digivolve two Digimon including my Digimon being attacked, what happens to the attack target?

qa.answer: No. Only one [Counter] effect can be triggered per an attack.
qa.question: After triggering this card's [Counter] effect, can I trigger another [Counter] effect?
Can this card's [Counter] effect change the attack target of one of my opponent's Digimon without DNA digivolving?
